sources.finding: The test processor assigns Gradle Test Executor as the worker base name.
The process builder combines that base name with a numeric id and appends the display name with literal surrounding apostrophes as the worker main argument.

implementation: test_executor_label requires exactly one GradleWorkerMain occurrence, exactly one trailing argument, normalizes only paired outer apostrophes, then full-matches Gradle Test Executor plus a numeric id. Both live observation and read-only audit apply the same matcher; audit also binds the separately recorded label to argv.
